title: Weekly Mood Scale, Safety Plan, and When to Seek Emergency Help
summary: A practical tool for parents: (1) Weekly mood scale (1-10 chart for mood/energy/sleep) — a decline for more than two weeks = visit a specialist. (2) Personal safety plan: my warning signs, calming strategies, trusted people, emergency numbers (937 in Saudi Arabia / 112 international). (3) Emergency: suicidal thoughts, a specific plan, available means, previous self-harm — call 937/112 immediately, do not leave them alone.
try_this: This week: Create a "safety card" together, pocket-sized — write: 3 warning signs, 3 calming strategies, 3 trusted people + 937. Keep it in a wallet/phone.
reflection_prompts: Was the card easy to understand?
Did your son feel safe having it?
